mapper.select: SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM search_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND NOW() GROUP BY keyword HAVING cnt >= 10 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM search_log WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT COUNT(1) as cnt FROM search_log

SELECT keyword, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM search_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND NOW() GROUP BY keyword HAVING cnt >= 10 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ( SELECT keyword FROM search_log WHERE created_at BETWEEN DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND NOW() GROUP BY keyword HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) AS temp
